about: Hand triage of henka's missed mutants on juice (results/2026-11-06-win32-juice-henka.json), by reading each against packages/juice/src. Keys are file:line:column from the mutant label. A missed mutant not listed here is a gap. uncovered: on code V8 reports as never run. branch: on a line that ran, in a branch that never runs. equivalent: changes nothing a test could observe. tuning: a default a designer would tune; a test that catches it would pin the value.
